name: Question Prism
hypothesis: Decompose a civilizational question by four different epistemic obligations rather than answer it as one claim.
algorithm: Typed partition of declared facets into OBSERVATION, FORECAST, VALUE, ACTION with explicit missing kinds.
potential_impact: Prevent factual evidence from silently answering a normative question.
falsifier: A question with all four facets must retain four distinct accountable outputs; malformed type must HOLD.
integration_surface: AtlasGPT query intake / House advisory builder

name: Negative-Space Ledger
hypothesis: Give unanswered requirements an explicit place instead of treating silence as falsification.
algorithm: Set difference of required observations, observed evidence and actively refuted claims.
potential_impact: Expose consequential unknowns in otherwise impressive graph coverage.
falsifier: A missing source cannot appear in the refuted set; denied private scope must not leak existence.

name: Source Kinship Lens
hypothesis: Detect when five apparent citations come from one declared research lineage.
algorithm: Deduplicate by explicit root publication family, retaining all derivative IDs.
potential_impact: Counter source multiplication and promote genuinely independent replication.
falsifier: Preprint+journal same root must count one declared family, never one verified witness.

name: Evidence Tide Clock
hypothesis: Prioritize revisiting studies whose declared review horizon has elapsed.
algorithm: Compare independently supplied observation-day, review cadence and frozen clock.
potential_impact: Keep a living civilizational knowledge base aware of temporal drift without erasing history.
falsifier: Old study becomes review-due, not false; future observation timestamp must HOLD.

name: Contradiction Fingerprints
hypothesis: Make contradictory readings durable, discoverable graph objects.
algorithm: Stable hash of subject and sorted supporting/challenging source IDs; preserve both sides.
potential_impact: Convert disagreements into reproducible experiments instead of invisible averaging.
falsifier: Source order shuffle must preserve conflict; removed dissent must change fingerprint.
integration_surface: Graph Fabric typed contradiction edge review

name: Ecotone Detector
hypothesis: Look for promising interdisciplinary research at boundaries between different Houses.
algorithm: Exact bounded shared vocabulary candidates across HSN source nodes with distinct Houses.
potential_impact: Find cross-domain opportunities while guarding against keyword false friends.
falsifier: Shared word produces only LEXICAL_ECOTONE_REVIEW_ONLY, not SAME_AS.

name: Curiosity Walk Compiler
hypothesis: Construct the shortest source-addressed inquiry that crosses Houses and visits a method-audit Node.
algorithm: Bounded BFS over explicit proposal edges with exact HSN kind and House checks.
potential_impact: Require an interdisciplinary science question to carry a methodological counterpoint.
falsifier: No method Node or forged kind must not produce a qualified walk.

name: Meta-Lens Carousel
hypothesis: Rotate among relevant methodological perspectives to avoid habitual selection of one critic.
algorithm: Deterministic cycle over explicit S08–S12 META coordinates with subject distinct from lens.
potential_impact: Improve epistemic diversity without pretending the methods are independent people.
falsifier: Domain coordinates cannot masquerade as META review; missing subject must HOLD.
integration_surface: Child Specialty Passport / meta methodology reviewer

name: Semantic Friction Gauge
hypothesis: Make crosswalk uncertainty visible before any attempt at semantic identity.
algorithm: Count missing externally declared edition, digest, rights, witness and challenge prerequisites.
potential_impact: Identify fragile graph joins for targeted review.
falsifier: Missing witness creates review requirement; zero missing does not auto-authorize SAME_AS.
integration_surface: Graph Fabric crosswalk reviewer / Atlas ONE

name: Orphan Compass
hypothesis: Allocate exploratory attention to underrepresented but potentially consequential Nodes.
algorithm: Rank unmapped HSN coordinates by declared relevance, then lower neighbor coverage, with deterministic ties.
potential_impact: Avoid repeatedly researching already-popular Spheres.
falsifier: Selecting an orphan never changes its mapped status.

name: Falsifier Ladder
hypothesis: Produce question-type-specific routes to disconfirm a proposed relationship.
algorithm: Templates for correlations, forecasts, causes and equivalence rather than generic tests.
potential_impact: Raise the rate of useful negative experiments.
falsifier: Generated test descriptions must not claim executed experiments.
integration_surface: AtlasGPT Work experiment design / SwarmChat challenge

name: Perturbation Margin
hypothesis: Reveal how easily a synthetic decision reverses under small explicitly chosen changes.
algorithm: Find minimum supplied shock that crosses a declared threshold.
potential_impact: Spot brittle policies before expensive simulation or real deployment.
falsifier: Out-of-range shocks/nonfinite scalars must HOLD; no claim of empirical margin.

name: Tradeoff Witness
hypothesis: Keep explicit reasons why an alternative is Pareto-dominated or excluded by hard rights constraints.
algorithm: Two-axis benefit/cost Pareto check after non-compensable rights filtering.
potential_impact: Explain why a seemingly attractive option was rejected.
falsifier: A high-benefit rights-denied option must never enter the frontier.

name: Dissent Conservation
hypothesis: Keep the smallest distinct objection IDs for each affected community across the entire council tree.
algorithm: Deduplicate only identical (group, objectionId), retaining all unique source pointers.
potential_impact: Stop House synthesis from accidentally erasing the minority position.
falsifier: Duplicate repeat cannot count as independent new objection; original remains.

name: Consensus Stress Test
hypothesis: Measure whether a synthetic agreement depends on one contributor or input.
algorithm: Leave-one-signal-out stress test at a declared fixed threshold.
potential_impact: Identify fragile agreement without treating model votes as democracy.
falsifier: One withdrawal must flag reversal; peer authentication remains unverified.

name: Reversible Experiment Genome
hypothesis: Bundle every research intervention with a prerequisite graph and a tested rollback draft.
algorithm: Deterministic topological order plus reverse rollback list; cycles HOLD.
potential_impact: Make research iterations genuinely reversible before they touch production.
falsifier: Cyclic or missing prerequisite must fail; returned steps are never executed.
integration_surface: GrokSeek planner → existing Atlas ONE Work Burst

name: Citation Capsule Diet
hypothesis: Fit a minimum evidence coverage envelope inside a bounded context budget without hiding missing claims.
algorithm: Cost-aware greedy set-cover with explicit uncovered claims and no source-body reads.
potential_impact: Better context loading under fixed token limits without silently dropping source provenance.
falsifier: Under-budget must return missing-claim list; no empirical optimality claim.
integration_surface: AtlasGPT context adapter / Brain Work citations

name: Mutation Atlas
hypothesis: Autogenerate high-value red-team mutations for source, version and mode contracts.
algorithm: Five deterministic corruptions of a typed candidate packet, not actual host requests.
potential_impact: Turn every integration interface into a source of its own adversarial checks.
falsifier: Every resulting invalid packet should be held by the production boundary under separate hosted proof.
integration_surface: Atlas ONE test runner / SwarmChat host validation

name: Wire Parity Mirror
hypothesis: Compare exactly equivalent receipts across independent JSON key orderings and language ports.
algorithm: Canonical recursive object-key ordering, digest equality and explicit mismatch detection.
potential_impact: Prevent silent drift across Atlas Intelligence, AtlasGPT and SwarmChat adapters.
falsifier: Nested reorder must preserve parity; changed value must fail parity.

name: META145 Unknown Dividend
hypothesis: Allocate voluntary research opportunities across Houses to uncover the most consequential *declared* unknowns.
algorithm: Budgeted deterministic ranking of unknown-reduction proxies with per-House cap and opt-in filter.
potential_impact: Provide an exploration policy that does not merely reward already-evidenced Spheres.
falsifier: Nonvolunteers never selected; metric is proxy, not observed information gain.
integration_surface: META145 advisory engine / opt-in SwarmChat task hints
